name: 祥子与素世 · 花园牵手

description.zh: 浅蓝色长直发，金色眼睛，黑色发带。
description.en: long straight light blue hair, golden eyes, and black hair ribbons.

description.zh: 浅棕色波浪长发，浅蓝色眼睛。
description.en: long light brown wavy hair and light blue eyes.

positive.zh: {{A}} 站在画面左侧，{{B}} 站在画面右侧，两人身体微微转向彼此。{{A}} 将左手伸向两人之间，{{B}} 用右手轻轻握住 {{A}} 的左手，牵着的两只手自然放在腰部下方。{{A}} 的右手放松地垂在身体外侧，{{B}} 的左手也放松地垂在身体外侧。{{A}} 看着 {{B}}，脸颊微红，抿起嘴唇，露出努力掩饰害羞的倔强表情。{{B}} 看着 {{A}}，露出温柔而略带得意的微笑。镜头位于两人正前方、与眼睛齐平，画面从头顶取景到大腿中部，两人之间留出空隙，牵手处完整可见。身后是一条花园小径、绿树和一张白色长椅。
positive.en: {{A}} stands on the left side of the image, and {{B}} stands on the right, with both bodies angled slightly inward. {{A}} extends the left hand toward the center, and {{B}} gently holds {{A}}'s left hand with the right hand. The joined hands rest naturally below waist level. {{A}}'s free right hand rests at the outer side of the body, and {{B}}'s free left hand also rests at the outer side. {{A}} looks at {{B}} with a faint blush and pressed lips, trying to hide a shy expression behind a stubborn look. {{B}} looks at {{A}} with a gentle, slightly pleased smile. The camera faces both girls from the front at eye level, framing the composition from the tops of the heads to mid-thigh. A small gap separates the two bodies, and the joined hands are fully visible. A garden path, green trees, and a white bench are in the background.

blocks.name: 画质、手部与双人结构约束

notes: 先使用现有 Anima 工作流的模型与参数进行对比。角色定义保存身份和外貌；标签保持简短，动作段明确左右站位和四只手的位置。该配方仅完成结构校验，尚未实际出图；文本分块不等于区域控制。
